home.meta_title: Slowtime — Book your car wash online
home.meta_desc: Slowtime connects drivers with the best car wash stations in Canada. Pick your slot, pay online, arrive on time.

hero.desc: Slowtime connects drivers with the best car wash stations near them. Pick your slot, pay online, arrive on time — your bay is waiting.

features.title: Your car deserves
features.item_1_desc: Book your bay in advance. Arrive at the exact time. Never again face a bad surprise or endless waiting for a spot.
features.item_2_desc: Pay online via Stripe before arriving. Your banking data never passes through our servers. Automatic receipt by email.
features.item_3_desc: You receive a reminder 24h before, 6h before and 45 minutes before your service. Confirm your presence in one click from the notification.
features.item_4_desc: Every review is tied to a real booking. Choose your station with confidence thanks to genuine customer ratings.
features.item_5_desc: One tap on Join and Google Maps opens with directions to your station. The station is notified that you are on your way.
features.item_6_desc: Unexpected event? Cancel or reschedule directly from the app. Automatic refund via Stripe per the station policy.

steps.title: Clean in
steps.step_1_desc: Search available stations near you. Browse hours, pricing by vehicle format, customer reviews and available slots in real time.
steps.step_2_desc: Choose your slot, select your vehicle format and pay online. Your spot is guaranteed instantly after Stripe confirmation.
steps.step_3_desc: You receive your reminders, confirm your presence in one click. Arrive on time — your bay is waiting. Service done, rate your experience.

stations_preview.title: The best stations in Montreal,
stations_preview.desc: Clear pricing, real-time hours, verified reviews. Choose by budget, vehicle format and neighborhood.

notifications.title: Never miss your
notifications.desc: Slowtime accompanies you from booking to the end of service. Confirm, report a delay or request a reschedule directly from your notification.
notifications.feat_1_desc: A first reminder the day before so you never forget
notifications.feat_2_desc: Two proximity reminders with direct action buttons
notifications.feat_3_desc: Notify the station in one tap from the push notification
notifications.feat_4_desc: Share your experience to help other customers
notifications.notif_1_body: Your wash at AutoSpa Premium is scheduled for tomorrow morning.
notifications.notif_2_body: Confirm your presence or report a delay.
notifications.notif_3_body: Rate your experience at AutoSpa Premium.

testimonials.title: What our
testimonials.t1_quote: I book in 30 seconds from my phone. I arrive, my bay is ready, I leave. That is exactly what I was looking for.
testimonials.t2_quote: The 45-minute reminders are perfect. I have never missed my slot again. And the automatic refund when I had to cancel was instant.
testimonials.t3_quote: I found my regular station through Slowtime. Reviews are genuine, listed prices are the real prices. No surprise on arrival.

faq.title: Everything you
faq.a1: Yes, registration and use of Slowtime are entirely free for customers. You only pay for the wash service at the price listed by the station.
faq.q2: How does the refund work when cancelling?
faq.a2: If you cancel within the allowed period, an automatic refund is initiated via Stripe. A penalty may apply for late cancellations per the station policy.
faq.a3: Absolutely. Payment is handled by Stripe, one of the most secure platforms in the world. Your card data never passes through Slowtime servers.
faq.q4: What happens if I am late?
faq.a4: Report your delay from the 45-min notification. The station can accept it or move you into the queue. If you report nothing, no-show fees may apply.
faq.a5: Slowtime is currently live in Montreal and its region. Expansion to other Quebec cities is planned.
faq.q6: How do I request account deletion?
faq.a6: In accordance with Law 25, you can export or delete your data at any time from Settings in the app.

problem.title: Your station deserves better than
problem.desc: Every customer who leaves because of a too-long queue is lost revenue. Slowtime turns uncertainty into planning and walk-in customers into guaranteed bookings.
problem.card_1_desc: Customers leave when they see too many people. You lose revenue without even knowing it.
problem.card_2_desc: Impossible to plan your staff and costs without visibility on the day traffic.
problem.card_3_desc: Your potential customers search online and do not find you. They go to the competitor.
problem.card_4_desc: A satisfied customer rarely comes back without a system that brings them back to you.
